in_hebrew.name: איי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Iy comes from the Hebrew word 'איי' which means 'breath'. This name can be seen as a reminder of the breath of life given by God to all living beings.

in_greek.name: Ιώ
in_greek.long_meaning: Io, in Greek mythology, was the mother of Zeus. The name Iy could be derived from this Greek goddess name.

in_latin.name: Ihus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Iy in Latin can be translated to Ihus, which means 'youth' or 'health'. This name reflects the idea of new beginnings and vitality.
